title: seo_seed configuration
description: Configuration for the seo_seed build generator, read from seo.yaml (or the path given to --config). Every key is optional and provides the default for the matching CLI flag, so a command-line flag always overrides the file.

output.description: Build output directory: where the Flutter web shell (index.html) is read from and generated pages are written. Overridden by --output / -o.

base-url.description: Site origin, e.g. https://sortd.app. Setting it enables absolute canonical/Open Graph URLs and writes sitemap.xml and robots.txt. Overridden by --base-url.

base-href.description: Overrides the shell's <base href>. Must start and end with a slash, e.g. '/app/' for subpath hosting or '/' for the root. Overridden by --base-href.

incremental.description: Skip regenerating pages that have not changed since the last build, keyed by SeoParams.version. Overridden by --incremental.

concurrency.description: Number of pages to generate concurrently, overlapping I/O in the metadata/content callbacks (e.g. API calls). Cooperative concurrency in a single isolate, so size it to your API's rate limits. Overridden by --concurrency / -j.
